reply.text:
That sounds like a rough week, and I'm glad you said it out loud. I won't build a fat burning plan on top of skipped meals. Under-eating makes training feel worse and tends to backfire, so the first step is eating regularly again. If the way you feel about your body or food is weighing on you, a doctor or a dietitian is a good person to talk to.

What I can do is set up training you can recover from and a steady routine around it. If you want, tell me how many days a week you can train and how long you have, and I'll build it. The app can also work out calorie and protein targets from your own numbers, with safe floors.
